hooks.name: Grid check when a page file is saved
hooks.description: Every save of pages/*.page runs the validator over all pages. A page that does not fit 40x24 is reported at once, with row and column.

action.command: .kiro/hooks/scripts/log-fire.sh PostFileSave pages grid:check; npm run -s grid:check 2>&1 | tail -6

hooks.name: Grid check after a write tool touches pages or compilers
hooks.description: Same check, bound to the write tools, because file-save events are an editor event and may not exist in a headless CLI run.

action.command: .kiro/hooks/scripts/log-fire.sh PostToolUse write grid:check; npm run -s grid:check 2>&1 | tail -6
